verdict.rationale: Docs describe exactly this capability: multi-step 'Session Workflow' that navigates URLs, orchestrates sub-tasks, and extracts data, plus a live_url to watch the agent act, and a community commenter confirms 'I just wrote a complex prompt and it did a good job.'
